journeys.name: Team release
journeys.description: Prepare a release using the team's required validation gates.
journeys.objective: Inspect project health and Git scope. Build every supported target, run the relevant tests, review the final diff, and prepare a local commit preview. Stop when a required gate fails. Never push or publish without explicit user authorization.

policies.name: Team architecture
policies.description: Review code using the team's shared architecture policy.
policies.instructions: Review the selected Delphi code for dependency direction, public API stability, memory ownership, thread safety, testability, and compatibility with the supported Delphi versions. Return evidence and concrete corrections.
